priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore removal of the message handler during cleanup
findings.body: When callers invoke the returned disposer while the socket remains active, the handler continues receiving messages. Repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, retain captured memory, and duplicate message processing.

findings.title: [P2] Restore interval cancellation during cleanup
findings.body: After callers invoke the returned disposer, `refresh` still runs every second. Repeated start/cleanup cycles accumulate timers and work; in Node.js, the live interval can also prevent process shutdown indefinitely.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns a no-op disposer after registering `handler` with `socket.on("message", handler)`. The full PR diff confirms this PR replaces the previous `socket.off("message", handler)` cleanup, so listeners remain active after disposal.
